description: This file defines an interface 'LoanProductTemplates' for creating and customizing loan product configurations, including predefined templates for different loan scenarios, used in integration tests within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanProductTemplates
classes.description: An interface providing methods to generate loan product templates for testing, including predefined configurations and customizations.

methods.name: getAssetAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID for a given asset account name.

methods.name: getLiabilityAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID for a given liability account name.

methods.name: getIncomeAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID for a specified income account name.

methods.name: getExpenseAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID for a specified expense account name.

methods.name: onePeriod30DaysNoInterest
methods.description: Creates a loan product request with a single period of 30 days and no interest.

methods.name: fourInstallmentsCumulative
methods.description: Creates a loan product request with four cumulative installments.

methods.name: fourInstallmentsProgressive
methods.description: Creates a loan product request with four progressive installments.

methods.name: fourInstallmentsProgressiveWithCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Creates a progressive installment loan with income capitalization.

methods.name: fourInstallmentsCumulativeTemplate
methods.description: Defines a template for a four installment cumulative loan product.

methods.name: customizeProduct
methods.description: Applies custom modifications to a given loan product template.
